verdict.rationale: Warp's first-party docs name official TypeScript (warp-hr) and Go (github.com/TeamWarp/warp-go-sdk) SDKs that handle authentication, pagination, retries, error handling, and webhook verification. The quickstart describes idiomatic, fully typed code for Node.js, browser, or any fetch-capable runtime. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDKs, and SDKs for languages beyond TypeScript and Go (e.g. Python).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Use the TypeScript SDK (warp-hr) or Go SDK (github.com/TeamWarp/warp-go-sdk) for authentication, pagination, retries, error handling, and webhook verification.
Call the API from Node.js, the browser, or any `fetch`-capable runtime with idiomatic, fully typed code.
